title: Izaak Walton Park
specs: 110 acres property with firearm ranges, archery ranges, fishing pond, and campgrounds
Annual ladies-only 'Women on Target' shooting event
Complete 6 hours of service to the chapter for permanent Range Badge
Range Qualified badge holders must be 18 years or older
Youth under 18 must be Junior Chapter members to participate in shooting sports
Family memberships include two adults 18 or older living in the same household
includes: Use of firearm ranges when Range Safety Officers are present
gap: Exact prices for archery tournament entry fees not stated
blurb: Guests can become members by attending a 3-hour New Member Orientation Class and paying initiation and annual fees. Members have access to firearm ranges when Range Safety Officers are present and can participate in archery tournaments and youth shooting sports. The chapter also offers a catch-and-release fishing pond, campgrounds, and a ladies-only shooting event.
extraNote: Dues are annual and must be paid by December 31; late fee applies after · Members may bring guests up to three times a year; some ranges have guest fees · Immediate family members may be guests unlimited times without fees
